name: agent-proxy
title: Agent Proxy
description: Ask quick questions and chat with AI right in Raycast, powered by the coding agents you already have installed (Codex CLI, more providers coming soon). No API keys, no extra subscription.
author: hinkolas

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask Question
commands.subtitle: Agent Proxy
commands.description: Get a quick answer without starting a chat. Assign it as a fallback command to ask straight from the root search.

commands.name: chat
commands.title: Quick Chat
commands.subtitle: Agent Proxy
commands.description: Chat with AI inside Raycast. Switch between earlier chats from the dropdown.

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Provider
preferences.description: The installed agent that answers your questions. More providers (Claude Code, OpenCode) are coming soon.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the codex executable. Leave empty to detect it automatically.

preferences.name: reasoningEffort
preferences.title: Reasoning Effort
preferences.description: How long the model thinks before answering. Lower is faster.

preferences.name: webSearch
preferences.title: Web Search
preferences.label: Allow web search
preferences.description: Let the agent search the web for current information.

preferences.name: customInstructions
preferences.title: Custom Instructions
preferences.description: Added to every conversation, e.g. "Answer in German" or "I am a TypeScript developer".

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
